scripts.dev:electron: tsc --project tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/write-electron-package-type.cjs && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/write-electron-package-type.cjs && vite build
scripts.package: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.make: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
